title: VISA OCT & AFT Certification
subtitle: Original Credit & Account Funding Transaction Certification
challenge: Certify support for two Visa transaction types on the bank's card platform: OCT (Original Credit Transaction), a real-time push/credit transaction used to disburse funds directly to a card (e.g. payouts, refunds, P2P transfers), and AFT (Account Funding Transaction), a debit-side transaction used to pull funds from a card to fund an account or wallet.
solution: Implemented and certified ISO 8583 message flows for both OCT (credit/push) and AFT (debit/funding) transaction types, enabling the bank to support real-time fund disbursement and account funding use cases on Visa's network.
role: Designed and implemented ISO 8583 message handling for OCT and AFT transaction types.
Led SIT and UAT with Visa and coordinated the certification process.
Developed and configured host-side logic for credit (OCT) and debit (AFT) transaction processing.
Managed production rollout following successful certification.
keyFeatures: OCT (Original Credit Transaction) processing - real-time push/credit to card
AFT (Account Funding Transaction) processing - debit-side account funding
Support for payouts, refunds, P2P, and wallet-funding use cases
results: Certified the bank's platform for both OCT and AFT transaction types with Visa.
Enabled real-time credit disbursement (OCT) and account/wallet funding (AFT) use cases.
Expanded the bank's card product capabilities to support modern payout and funding flows.
